name: rerunner
description: Deterministic flight recorder, replay engine, and CI test runner for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic flight recorder and replay engine for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Inspect recorded LLM and tool cassettes, verify SHA-256 chains and PII redaction, fork trajectories from any step, and scaffold deterministic pytest tests.
defaultPrompt: Use Rerunner to inspect this failed agent cassette and find where it diverged.
Use Rerunner to verify SHA-256 integrity and scan this cassette for leaked secrets before committing.
Use Rerunner to fork this cassette from step 3 and generate a deterministic pytest regression test.
